entities.description: A light-colored wooden sideboard or dresser with a mid-century modern design, featuring four drawers arranged in a 2x2 grid with small, dark, round knobs. The furniture has tapered legs and a smooth finish, with a camera and other items resting on its top surface.

A light wood bookshelf with a simple, modern design stands in the background, featuring open shelves holding a row of books with white and light-colored spines. The furniture has a natural finish and clean lines, positioned behind a person in the foreground.

An elderly woman with short, wavy white hair stands with a somber expression, looking downward while holding a wooden cane in her right hand. She wears a light blue button-down shirt with rolled sleeves and beige trousers, while a caregiver in blue scrubs stands behind her with hands placed gently on her shoulders.

A young Asian woman with dark hair tied back in a ponytail and wearing black-rimmed glasses is dressed in a light blue short-sleeved medical scrub top and matching pants. She stands behind an elderly woman, placing her hands gently on the older woman's shoulders in a supportive posture while looking down at her.
